query:
SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint
        FROM messages m
        JOIN threads t ON t.id = m.thread_id
        WHERE m.role = 'agent'
          AND m.msg_type = 'tool'
          AND (m.content LIKE 'search_messages:%' OR m.content LIKE 'search_wiki:%')
          AND m.created_at >= $1
          AND ($2 = '' OR t.profile = $3)
